title: index-tree payload
description: Every tracked markdown file, arranged by the index.md hierarchy, plus every one no index reaches.

root.description: The checkout root as a directory node; its identity is the empty string.

unindexed.description: The file nodes the walk never reached, sorted by identity.

directory.description: One directory row: the facts its index.md carries, and what it lists.

identity.description: The repo-relative path with a trailing slash, empty for the root.

title.description: The index's H1, or the directory name when the index is missing.

description.description: The first sentence of the index's introduction.

children.description: The rows this directory holds, its own index.md first, then listing order.

file.description: One file row: its frontmatter facts.

type.description: The frontmatter type, null when the file carries none.

title.description: The frontmatter title, null when the file carries none.

description.description: The frontmatter description, null when the file carries none.

exists.description: False when an index lists a file the checkout does not carry.
